messages:
Ravi: Quick post 19: ran a compact bring-up for 'horizon-lite-9b' quant int6 vs int8. Short econ + ops notes below.

Iris: Nice — what slices did you run?

Ravi: Three focused slices: short-chat (60% traffic sim), retrieval/search (25%), document-summarization (15%). Used our lightweight harness, 300 samples per slice.

Noah: Top-line delta?

Ravi: Infra unit cost (1k tokens): int8=$0.011, int6=$0.0065 (~40% savings). Latency p95: int8=110ms, int6=200ms on our standard inference setup. Throughput down ~15% on int6.

Iris: Quality tradeoffs? Any concentrated failure modes?

Ravi: Avg quality small drop but concentrated: chat QA mean -0.03 (5pt scale), search MRR -0.7% absolute, summarization ROUGE-L -0.6. Hallucination proxy up ~0.4% with spikes for numeric/date extraction. Variance higher on multi-turn threads.

Noah: CI and noise?

Ravi: 300 samples gives decent signal but still noisy for MRR (<0.5% CI). Recommend 1k-sample shadow batch for search before routing changes.

Iris: Suggested rollout?

Ravi: Operational sketch: 1) Hybrid routing by slice: keep int8 for retrieval and any numeric-exactness endpoints; use int6 for short-chat and low-stakes summarization. 2) Canary: shadow 1k sample + 48h live split: chat 5%, search 15% with auto rollback if MRR drops >0.6% or halluc proxy >1.0%. 3) Prompt guards: detect multi-step numeric prompts and force-int8. 4) Cost knobs: enable longer prefix cache TTL for summarization to reduce recurring token spend.

Noah: Can you paste a tiny routing rule mock?

Ravi: Sure (pseudo):
```
if request.slice in ("retrieval","billing") -> model: horizon-lite-9b-int8
elif request.slice == "chat" and tokens < 1200 -> horizon-lite-9b-int6
else -> horizon-lite-9b-int8
```

Iris: For GTN note we need expected savings band and a short risk statement.

Ravi: Draft blurb: "Int6 yields ~35-45% infra savings with modest average quality regressions concentrated in numeric and retrieval use-cases. Recommend targeted hybrid routing and a 48h canary with strict MRR/hallucination gates before broader rollouts."

Noah: Good. Action items: Ravi run 1k-sample shadow for search, produce short one-pager for GTN, list top 10 prompt patterns that trigger failures. OpsBot: schedule canary after Ravi uploads 1k results.

OpsBot: Acknowledged. Will schedule canary: horizon-lite-9b-int6 chat route 5% start=2026-03-24T09:00Z. Monitor MRR, latency_p95, halluc_proxy.

Iris: Thanks team. Drop the 1k link here when ready and we'll prep GTN messaging.
